text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby has arrived. 
I want to head to the venue in high 
spirits, but—

"Seiun Sky didn't show up at the meeting 
spot for the Satsuki Sho. Taking that to 
heart..."

I had a secret plan prepared for this 
occasion.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Hup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Look, I banged on their door and woke them 
up just as requested! They were quite the 
sleepyhead though, so I was sweating for a 
bit!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd actually bring out Hishi 
Ama-san... Trainer, that's totally taking 
it too far~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nah, your partner gave me a great job to 
do! As the Miho Dorm head, it's totally 
worth my while!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna keep dragging your butt out of 
bed before important races, so you'd 
better be ready!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sheesh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, taking it easy might be nice. With 
changing clothes and all.”

This resolves Seiun Sky's 'gate entry 
difficulty.' All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know if we can win or not, but 
let's give it a go~."
(WOOOAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, as expected of the Derby. The cheers 
are on a whole other level.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's not just because it's the Derby. It's 
a showdown between the Big Three!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, hello there! You're in top form 
today too, King~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am the first-class King! There is no 
such thing as an off day for me!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"So, I won't lose to anyone today! Not to 
you—and not to Special Week-san either!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Special Week—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave her be. She looks super 
focused right now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...Indeed. This Derby is her dream."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But... I won't back down either!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, I can't wait! Today's all about 
Special Week after all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's always said she wanted to win the 
Derby. She's head and shoulders above the 
rest of the Big Three, so I really want 
her to win here...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well now. Looks like Spe-chan is the heavy 
favorite... or so it seems.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, naturally. After all, she's aiming 
squarely for *this* moment.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still—there's no reason that dream of 
winning the Derby can't belong to me, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-san!
